Title: Issues and challenges of Gbps backplane connector characterization
PublicationSource: 8th IEEE Workshop on Signal Propagation on Interconnects
ShortAbstract: This work investigates the challenges of characterizing high-speed backplane connectors operating at gigabit data rates. Using a 50 Ω single-ended ERNI prototype connector, 3D full-wave electromagnetic simulations are compared with measurements, and various de-embedding techniques are evaluated. The results highlight the significant influence of connector footprints on overall signal integrity and electrical performance.
